thread.title: Special Participation B: Perplexity Pro on HW12
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>After finishing the notebooks using Perplexity Pro, I was surprised with how quickly and correctly the model was able to give me the correct answer. Granted, this homework assignment's coding portion was relatively easier, but I was expecting worse since Perplexity is not a model made specifically for coding tasks. I did this homework with Perplexity by giving the model the entire files/notebooks and asking it to fill in all the Todos. I think since the Todos are clearly labeled and good reference information is given, it is very easy for an LLM to know what to do.<break/><break/></paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/h6qgMp66S6TiqJzcGizQV3kq" filename="Special Participation HW 12.pdf"/></document>
thread.document: After finishing the notebooks using Perplexity Pro, I was surprised with how quickly and correctly the model was able to give me the correct answer. Granted, this homework assignment's coding portion was relatively easier, but I was expecting worse since Perplexity is not a model made specifically for coding tasks. I did this homework with Perplexity by giving the model the entire files/notebooks and asking it to fill in all the Todos. I think since the Todos are clearly labeled and good reference information is given, it is very easy for an LLM to know what to do.
